draft.subject: A possible tax offset — to confirm with wealth planning first
draft.english:
Dear [[FIRST_NAME]],

There may be a tax point in your portfolio worth looking at. I want to raise it carefully, because it depends on facts I need to confirm with you first.

Across your holdings there are about USD 1.1m of losses on paper and about USD 1.8m of gains. The largest loss is on the US Treasury 3.875% due 2049, at about USD 0.5m. Our records show you as taxed in Thailand, and if that is still correct, realising some of the losses might be set against the gains.

I am not suggesting any sale yet. What I would suggest is that our wealth planning colleagues first confirm where you are taxed today and how the rules would apply, including whether buying a holding back soon afterwards would cancel the benefit.

Could I call you this week to explain and check the details?
